answer: An agent economy can weight votes on shared spending by escrowed stake rather than identity count. Whether an agent prices crystal, catalogs ivory artifacts, or maps a mesa, creating more accounts gives it no extra voting power: splitting 100 tokens among 100 identities still yields only 100 tokens of weight. To gain control, an attacker must acquire and lock enough stake to outweigh honest agents, tying up capital for the escrow period.
